text:
```yaml
name: Harness Drift Report
on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 1 * * *'  # Run daily at 1 AM UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  drift-report:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'
          cache: 'npm'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run drift check
        run: npm run drift-check

      - name: Generate drift report
        run: |
          npm run drift-report
          echo "Drift report generated successfully"

      - name: Create issue if drift detected
        if: failure()
        uses: peter-evans/create-issue-from-file@v5
        with:
          title: "Harness Drift Detected - Daily Report"
          content-filepath: "./drift-report.md"
          labels: "drift-report,automation"
          assignees: "cita-777"
```
